title: Webinar: The Qubits Attack - How to Prepare a Defence Against the Quantum Threat?
summary: National CERT.hr webinar notice addressing the quantum threat and how organisations can prepare a defence, explicitly covering post-quantum cryptography (postkvantna kriptografija), qubits, superposition and quantum cryptography.

title: Prilog C: Katalog kontrola
summary: Control catalogue (Annex C, version 1.1, revised 11 March 2026) published by the Information Systems Security Bureau for cybersecurity self-assessment. Control KRIP-005, application of quantum-resistant cryptography, covers evaluating existing cryptographic systems, planning migration to quantum-resistant algorithms and updating cryptographic policies, scored on a five-level maturity scale.

title: Prilog B: Okvir za evaluaciju mjera upravljanja kibernetičkim sigurnosnim rizicima
summary: Evaluation framework (Annex B, version 1.0) for self-assessment under Article 51 of the Regulation on Cybersecurity (Narodne novine 135/24), part of the Information Systems Security Bureau's self-assessment guidelines. It lists sub-measure 10.6, to use quantum-resistant cryptography against future threats where possible according to assessed risk, and sets maturity thresholds for control KRIP-005, assessed only where an entity adopts the sub-measure voluntarily.

title: CroQCI: Croatian Quantum Communication Infrastructure project
summary: CERT.hr's projects page describes CroQCI, the Croatian Quantum Communication Infrastructure project, which ran from 1 January 2023 to 30 June 2025. The project includes building and testing devices and systems that combine quantum, post-quantum, classical and quantum-enhanced solutions.
